scope: Feature 003 backend only; browser, redirect/event and full infrastructure recovery acceptance remain separate.

requirements.description: HTTP/HTTPS, absolute host, length, forbidden characters and credentials
Case, IDNA, trailing-dot and port-independent rejection of short-host aliases
No fetch, preview or DNS resolution of destinations
Full short URL and original destination; decimal ID and consistent timestamp
Owner-scoped concurrent replay, conflicts, intentional duplicates, lost response and current state
Atomic 24-hour expiry independent of cleanup jobs
Newest-first stable keyset paging, 50 default, 100 maximum, no row totals
Protected 24-hour cursor bound to owner, route, filters and limit; shared across replicas
Other owners cannot list, consult or deactivate a link; IDs return 404
No destination-edit API; exact trimmed path/query/fragment survives creation, replay and deactivation
Permanent idempotent owner deactivation preserves link and history; disabled takes precedence over blocked
Frozen case-sensitive Base62, positive BIGINT sequence, no padding or user-selected code
Length transitions, unique codes, rollback gaps, no reuse or change to existing codes
Confirmed inclusive external ranges, prefetch, outage and ambiguous-write recovery
Allocation restore requires suspension and positive writer fencing, skips past external reservations
Final partial range and BIGINT exhaustion without overflow or reuse
Real JWT/session revocation, no cookie identity, shared creation/read limits and sanitized errors
Upgrade and repeatable migration, schema constraints, cancellation and transactional rollback

externalAcceptance.006: Form states, copy feedback, confirmation dialogs, explicit retry/expiry UX, accessibility and browser journeys.
externalAcceptance.004-005: Public 302/410, exact Location, case-sensitive public resolution, event eligibility and historical reports.
externalAcceptance.007: Account deletion, retention and administrative workflows; this PR covers stored state precedence only.
externalAcceptance.008: Production fencing orchestration, backup/PITR, recovery of secrets and complete recovery exercises. Allocation preparation is implemented and tested here.
